description:
Create an interactive Riemann sum exploration in GeoGebra for the function f(x) = sin(x) on the interval [0, π]. 

Your applet must include:
1. The function f(x) = sin(x).
2. An integer slider 'n' (range 1 to 50) to control the number of rectangles.
3. The Upper Riemann Sum command linked to the slider.
4. The Lower Riemann Sum command linked to the slider.
5. The exact integral value (area under the curve) for comparison.
6. A text annotation displaying a value (e.g., 'Exact Area = 2' or dynamic sum values).

Save your project as 'riemann_sums.ggb' in the directory ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
